intentEvidence: Tag and classify notes with Jev (TypeSafe): records genre and category and generates folder and subject tags in the frontmatter.
problem: Manually classifying notes into specific genres and categories is time-consuming and inconsistent.

relations.evidence: sends 1 request to Jev (TypeSafe System One), which picks a categoria (field, 13 options) and a genero (subfield, 89 options)
the plugin sends to the TypeSafe API (api.typesafe.ai): the note title, its tags and up to N characters of the body

summary: AI-powered note classifier that uses the Jev (TypeSafe) API to categorize notes and automatically generate frontmatter properties and folder tags.
